title: Introduce telemetry-driven task remediation loop
summary: When runtime errors surface, route them through the ecosystem orchestrator and generate bounded remediation work orders.
constraints: do not assume a specific IDE implementation
capture reusable fix memory for future training
requestedOutcomes: identify impacted systems through graph relationships
create verification and learning tasks automatically

planner emits ecosystem, system, repo, verification, handoff, and learning orders
graph patch preview identifies impacted systems
